arc: hook/problem (overflowing inbox) → reveal (icon + name + phone) → benefit tagline → feature ×2 (remembers every client; drafts the 'no' to your boss in chat) → feature (calendar clash fixed by drag) → integrations (gig-app tiles orbit) → conversation (after-hours assistant chat) → cta end card

scenes.title: iOS Messages inbox whips down with motion blur
scenes.summary: A white iOS 'Messages' screen fills the square frame: pinned Priya, Boss and Dev avatars with a 'Need you Saturday 😤' status bubble over the boss, then rows like 'Dev — Can you ship it tonight?', 'Boss — Quick call?', 'Marco — Still on for the DJ gig? 🎧', 'Boss — Where are you?? 😤'. The camera eases in, then the list whips up ~1100px with outExpo and a vertical motion blur proportional to scroll speed, settling and drifting.
scenes.build: One tall canvas layer drawn once with ui.ts helpers (statusBar, glassPill, avatar, chevron) via kit.ts's Stage/Layer — a 2D compositor of CanvasTexture planes under an orthographic camera whose shader does directional blur, fade and pixel dissolve. Motion blur = `by` set from the scroll function's per-frame velocity (scrollAt(f+0.5) - scrollAt(f-0.5)).
scenes.reuse: Use for any 'drowning in messages/notifications' opener: edit ROWS and pins. The velocity-driven motion blur trick works on any scrolled layer. Avatars are template assets.

scenes.title: App icon pops, name blurs up letter by letter, then drops into a rising phone
scenes.summary: A dark rounded app icon with a peach-to-pink crescent moon, briefcase and sparkles pops in (outBack) at centre, and 'Moonlight' rises letter by letter with a blur. The letters blur away and the icon shrinks and arcs down into the pinned-contact slot of an iPhone Messages screen that rises from below, where Moonlight now sits between Priya and Dev with a verified badge. 'Your personal / assistant' blurs up above as a pink wash rises from the bottom.
scenes.build: Icon is drawn procedurally once (ui.ts buildIcon: gradient crescent via destination-out, briefcase, quadratic sparkles) and cached. Letters are individual textLayer()s animated with fx.ts blurUp (blur+rise+fade with optional exit). The icon's y/scale lerp lands exactly on the phone layer's pinned slot (PHONE_TOP + 380).
scenes.reuse: Strong 'meet the app' reveal: swap the icon drawing, name and tagline. The icon-lands-inside-the-UI handoff is the key idea. The crescent icon is brand-specific.

scenes.title: 'For a very active double life' with pink moons popping around it
scenes.summary: Over a pink wash, 'For a very active' blurs up word by word, then 'double life' slams in big (120px, weight 800) from a heavy blur and slight overscale. Six small glowing pink crescent moons pop and spin in around the words and bob, then everything lifts and blurs out.
scenes.build: kit.ts wordLayers + fx.ts blurUp with staggered starts; moons are tiny canvas layers (filled circle minus an offset circle via destination-out) animated with outBack scale and rotation.
scenes.reuse: A one-line tagline card; borrow only the decorative-glyph-pop idea. Swap copy and the glyph shape.

scenes.title: Avatar bubble cluster dissolves into three client profiles, camera pushes on the boss
scenes.summary: A soft lavender blob grows and fills with circular contact photos (Dev, Marco, Karen, Sam, Boss) and pastel dots that pop out from the centre and drift. The cluster pixel-dissolves away and three profiles slide in from the right: Boss '💼 likes overtime', Priya '🎨 likes pastels', Dev '🌙 likes dark mode', each with a coloured pill label. Priya and Dev soften and blur as the camera pushes in on the boss.
scenes.build: Blob is one canvas layer of shadowed overlapping circles; dots use fx.ts popIn with a scale-from-centre position lerp. The per-layer `dis` uniform in kit.ts's shader drives a hashed block dissolve. Focus is opacity + blur on the non-boss profiles; camera push via Stage.look() zoom/centre.
scenes.reuse: Use for 'knows your customers/contacts/team' beats: swap DOTS avatars and PEOPLE names/labels. The cluster→profiles dissolve and rack-focus push are reusable.

scenes.title: iMessage thread: AI suggests a polite decline, cursor clicks Send
scenes.summary: An iPhone iMessage chat with 'Boss' and a keyboard rises in: grey bubbles 'Hey, quick one 👋', 'Can you come in this Saturday? 🙏', and a blue reply 'Sure, I can come in 🙃'. The camera zooms 2× into the thread and the keyboard drops away; a 'Moonlight suggestion' label and a pink-glowing blue bubble 'Sorry, I've already got plans this weekend 🙂' blur up with chips 'No' and a gradient 'Send?'. A macOS cursor arcs in and clicks Send (chip squish), then the whole thing pixel-dissolves.
scenes.build: fx.ts chatPhone/keyboardLayer/bubbleLayer/chipsLayer/cursorLayer build canvas layers on shared PH/MSG geometry; bubbles placed by side with L()/R(). Cursor uses placeCursor with 1/zoom scaling so it stays a constant size while the camera zooms; click = bump().
scenes.reuse: Excellent reusable AI-suggestion-in-chat beat: swap contact, bubble lines and chip labels. The fx.ts chat kit (bubbles with tails, chips, keyboard, cursor) is the asset to borrow.

scenes.title: Week calendar: cursor drags a clashing gig into its own slot
scenes.summary: A clean iOS-style week view (S–S, 16–22, Friday 21 circled red) with an hour grid 5 PM–12 AM pixel-dissolves in. A blue 'Day job · standup 🏢' event at 6 PM overlaps a translucent purple 'DJ set with Marco 🎧' at 6:30. The cursor enters, grabs the gig (slight lift), drags it down to 7 PM and drops it; then the view dissolves out.
scenes.build: Grid and each event are canvas layers (eventLayer helper: rounded fill + colour bar + label); drag position interpolated with inOutCubic and the cursor's y follows the event's delta. Entry/exit via kit.ts `dis` block dissolve.
scenes.reuse: Use for scheduling/conflict-resolution features: swap days, hours, event labels and colours. Simple and clear.

scenes.title: Four app tiles hop around a 3D-ish orbit over a pink/blue glow
scenes.summary: Over soft pink and periwinkle radial glows, four rounded app tiles — a blue calendar '31', white Upwork, green Fiverr, black Uber — pop in and circle on a flattened ellipse. The ring advances a quarter turn in four eased hops; tiles at the back shrink, blur and sort behind those in front. They blur and fade out at the end.
scenes.build: Angle = slow linear drift + four 18-frame inOutCubic quarter-turn steps; depth = sin(angle) drives scale, blur and renderOrder (re-sorted per frame via layer.z()). Logos are SVG assets drawn into tile canvases via ui.ts tile().
scenes.reuse: Drop-in 'works with your apps' beat: swap TILES (fill + logo). Count can change by adjusting the angle spacing. Don't reuse the third-party logos without reason.

scenes.title: Assistant chat books a job and offers to ship, cursor taps 'Yes 😜'
scenes.summary: An iMessage thread with 'Moonlight': you ask 'Can you fit Priya's logo job in this week?', it replies 'Done! She's free at 9pm, after work. Does that work?', then under 'Today' 'Boss just logged off 🌙 Want me to send Dev the final build?' with chips 'No 😭' and 'Yes 😜'. The camera zooms to 1.75×, the cursor taps Yes, the phone blurs out and the app icon settles at centre for the end card.
scenes.build: Same fx.ts chat kit as scene 05. The end icon is placed in world space divided by the camera zoom so it lands on screen exactly at END_ICON, which 09-end-card.ts holds.
scenes.reuse: Second instance of the scene-05 chat pattern; borrow 05 first. The zoom-compensated icon handoff is the only new trick.

scenes.title: Icon end card: 'The most personal moonlighting assistant yet', fade to black
scenes.summary: The Moonlight app icon floats at centre on white as a pink wash rises from the bottom. 'The most personal' then 'moonlighting assistant yet' blur up word by word underneath. The frame fades to black over the last ~20 frames.
scenes.build: kit.ts wordLayers + fx.ts blurUp; ui.ts pinkWash layer slid up; a full-frame black layer's opacity is keyed 0 → 0.45 → 1.
scenes.reuse: Simple, clean app end card: swap the icon and two-line claim. Pair with a preceding scene that lands the icon at the same spot.
